purpose: Category-specific image quality gate for Airveek ecommerce photo-shoot content.
decision: Separate marketplace-compliant main images from attention-catching secondary/lifestyle images. Never use a plain background as the only image, and never let creative styling change the product being sold.

researchSignals.source: Google Merchant Center image link guidance
researchSignals.signal: Main images should accurately show the whole product, be high resolution, and use a simple background; staged or lifestyle images can also be acceptable when the product is clearly shown.

researchSignals.source: Google Merchant Center lifestyle image guidance
researchSignals.signal: Lifestyle images are intended to show products in a real-world context and should be distinctive, colorful, beautiful, and focused on the product in use or being showcased.

researchSignals.source: Google Merchant Center additional image guidance
researchSignals.signal: Additional images can show staging, use, detail views, and lifestyle context beyond the main image.

Marketplace main-image discipline is different from brand storytelling: clear, in-focus, product-dominant, white-background images are used for the primary listing view, while richer story assets belong in secondary content.
A useful product image system combines clean listing, lifestyle, packaging, close-up, and scale/context images; lifestyle images help shoppers imagine the product in their own life.
Product pages need a diverse image set with different jobs; rich visuals supplement rather than replace clear product images.
Beauty creative performs as product showcase plus useful education: show texture, routine, practical tips, and a clear product-focused visual story.

researchSignals.source: Pinterest reference pin supplied by the user
researchSignals.signal: The reference pattern pairs a finished commercial product image with a reusable prompt card. This is useful as a prompt-template source, but the prompt must still be checked against product truth and marketplace rules.

mainListing: Exact bottle, cap, dropper, label shape, color, and proportions must remain unchanged.
Product must be fully visible, sharp, and easy to recognize at thumbnail size.
Use a clean light background when the asset is used as a marketplace main image.
Do not invent readable claims, ingredient percentages, awards, or medical language.
secondaryLifestyle: Use one calm, believable skincare ritual: stone, water, soft botanical cue, or a clean vanity context.
Keep styling minimal and subordinate to the bottle; no prop may hide the label or dropper.
Use controlled reflections, contact shadow, and realistic liquid/glass behavior.
Leave crop-safe negative space and avoid generic empty gradients.
qualityChecks: Product identity match against the source image
Product remains the visual focal point
No duplicated product or generated text
Commercial lighting and believable physical contact

stagedAsset.generationMethod: built-in image generation edit with the supplied product image as edit target

hardGate: Do not record the 20-video batch until the user approves the staged visual direction and the first synchronized ECO01 replacement passes audio, framing, branding, and human visual review.
